info.title: Atelier internal service contracts
info.description: Generated from @atelier/contracts/src/v1.ts and src/routes.ts — do not hand-edit; run `pnpm openapi:generate`.

error.description: Human-readable message (kept for backward compatibility with existing clients)

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT

field.description: Present for VALIDATION_ERROR: the offending request field

get.summary: Get the caller's account profile (identity from a signed x-principal header, G-19)

patch.summary: Update the caller's own profile (identity from a signed x-principal header, G-19)

post.summary: Idempotently sync a Supabase identity to an account profile

get.summary: List curated collections with live artwork counts

post.summary: Create an artist-owned artwork listing

patch.summary: Update artwork metadata (resets verification to pending)

get.summary: Look up the artist profile owned by an Account user

post.summary: Idempotently provision the artist profile for an Account user (G-06 signup)

patch.summary: Apply a verification decision to an artwork's projection
Apply a verification decision to an artist's projection

post.summary: Atomically reserve an available artwork ahead of checkout
Commit a held reservation to sold (only if unexpired)
Release a held reservation back to available (idempotent)
Add an artwork to the buyer's cart

delete.summary: Remove an artwork from the buyer's cart

post.summary: Checkout the buyer's cart (fixed-price, idempotent)
Confirm a Stripe Checkout Session and finalize the order (idempotent)

get.summary: List orders for an artist's artworks

post.summary: Mark an order shipped (artist-owned)

403.description: Caller does not own this resource

post.summary: Buyer confirms receipt of a shipped order
Leave a review on a completed order
Toggle save/unsave for an artwork

get.summary: List the artists the buyer follows

post.summary: Toggle follow/unfollow for an artist
Record a verification decision for an artwork
Record a verification decision for an artist

get.summary: List static presets, or the buyer's saved rooms if buyerId is given

post.summary: Persist a buyer-owned room
Persist an artwork placement in a room
File a complaint against an order
Resolve or reject a complaint
